origin: AWS S3 s3://ecmwf-forecasts (ECMWF open data mirror, aifs-ens, via ecmwf-opendata client)
notes: No model in the repo (examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/, model docstrings, default sources) reads from this source; only tests, docs listings and CHANGELOG mention it. Variables are the AIFSLexicon VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/ecmwf.py:244).

DEVIATION from full VOCAB (109): lsm, sdor, slor are excluded (106 used). They exist only in the step-0 files, while the 6h accumulations (cp06, ro06, sf06, ssrd06, strd06, tp06) raise ValueError for lead < 6h (ecmwf.py:382), so no single lead time can serve all 109. Lead 6h maximises the count.
Availability of all 106 params was checked against the S3 .index file for 2026-06-01 00z step 6h, not by fetching them. Older cycles differ: on 2025-10-16 aifs-ens lacked cp and vsw (swvl1/swvl2).
Time must be a 6-hourly cycle >= 2025-07-01T06 (ecmwf.py validate_time); lead time 6h multiple, max 360h (validate_leadtime). One ecmwf-opendata retrieve (byte-range) per variable.
member=0 requests the control forecast (type cf); member>0 would read the much larger perturbed (pf) file.
